messages:
Claudia: Quick personal update — moved into a tiny SoMa studio last week and just accepted a promotion to Senior PM today! :tada: Thinking a small in-office celebration next week, cake + tiny plant?
Ravi: Huge congrats Claudia!! :confetti_ball:
Claudia: Thanks!! Wed 3pm or Thurs lunch — what works?
Nia: Wed 3pm for me. I can bring a vegan cake.
Jordan: Thurs lunch works better for me but can do Wed. I can grab savory trays.
Mira: Ill bring a little succulent as a housewarming gift. Congrats!! :seedling:
Sam: Senior PM!! so excited :raised_hands: I vote Wed for a toast before planning.
Kala: Wed is good. Ill book Conf B for 3:009:45 and send an invite. Anyone want to add a quick emoji poll: :cake: cake, :cupcake: cupcakes, :taco: empanadas?
Claudia: Vote time — honestly fine with anything but cake is my vibe. :smile:
Ravi: :cake:
Nia: :cupcake:
Jordan: :taco:
Mira: :cake: (but I will eat anything)
party-bot: Reminder created: "Claudia celebration" at 1718997600 (Wed 3pm) — 5 folks RSVP so far.
Claudia: Thank you all. Ill DM Kala about logistics. Also if anyone wants a low-key housewarming brunch on a Sunday later this month, open invite. No pressure. :heart:
